name: Self-Attenuation Rendering
aliases: Self-Attenuation Rendering — Exact Self-Attenuation, Self-Attenuation in 3DGS
definition: A rendering approach that correctly accounts for the attenuation of a Gaussian's own extinction along the ray path (self-attenuation), rather than ignoring it or using a first-order Taylor approximation.
summary: Self-Attenuation Rendering is a volumetric splatting technique that uses exact exponential extinction to eliminate visual inaccuracies and training instability caused by standard Taylor approximations.
